Both scope copies have the same Git blob. Both are corrected, with no severity promotion. No Important introduced or pre-existing defect was established.

Mechanical checks: none ran. Syntax, lint, manifest validation, runtime behavior and mutation sensitivity remain unverified; settling commands are listed in unverified. Session could write: no, enforced by the read-only sandbox. --run-checks: off. No files or mailbox messages were written. This session performed the review directly because Codex invocation and delegation were explicitly prohibited.

Result: success, complete reading review, zero Important findings. Batch 6 is clean at Important.
